model: On-device text classifier for rural triage priority
intended_use: Suggest a priority for visits WITHOUT alarm signs, inside a Web Worker, offline. Alarm-sign rules always take precedence. A health promoter confirms every suggestion.
not_for: Diagnosis or any real clinical decision. Academic prototype.

training_data.source: Synthetic, fictitious Spanish descriptions generated by ml/dataset.py
training_data.split: By scenario: test scenarios never appear in training

decision_rule: high if P(high) >= 0.59, else the likelier of medium and low
high_threshold_selection: Highest threshold reaching recall(high) >= 0.95 in 5-fold cross-validation grouped by scenario, on training data only
limitations: Synthetic data written by the developer: real promoter notes will differ.
Not validated by health professionals; the label scale is not an official triage scale.
Bag-of-words model: it can miss negations beyond bigrams ('no tiene ... fiebre').
Unknown words are ignored: very unusual descriptions fall back to the priors.
